under Section 1 04 of the Tariff and Customs Code 1978, as amended, shall
be accorded a minimum 50% MOP as specified in Column 9 thereof. In effect,
such articles shall be subject to the BBC Preferential Tariff in accordance with
the schedule indicated oppOsite each article as specified in Columns 10,11
and 12 of Annex "A".

Co., Ltd.) effective from 15 June 1995 up to 14 June 1999. Thereafter, the
same MOP may be granted to a non-participating

cars and on manual steering gear for Nissan AD Resort (Y 10) pick-ups shall
